primary_source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED) Public Data
frequency: Quarterly (resampled from monthly using quarterly arithmetic mean; GDP native quarterly)
revision_status: Revised historical series (subject to data revision bias; not real-time vintages)

GDPC1.title: Real Gross Domestic Product
GDPC1.units: Billions of Chained 2017 Dollars, Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate
GDPC1.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis / FRED
GDPC1.description: Inflation-adjusted measure of the value of all goods and services produced by the U.S. economy.

CPIAUCSL.title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items
CPIAUCSL.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics / FRED
CPIAUCSL.description: Monthly measure of the average change over time in prices paid by urban consumers for market basket.

UNRATE.title: Unemployment Rate
UNRATE.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics / FRED
UNRATE.description: Percentage of the civilian labor force that is unemployed.

FEDFUNDS.title: Federal Funds Effective Rate
FEDFUNDS.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System / FRED
FEDFUNDS.description: Volume-weighted median of overnight federal funds transactions.

INDPRO.title: Industrial Production: Total Index
INDPRO.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System / FRED
INDPRO.description: Measures the real output of manufacturing, mining, and electric and gas utilities.

GS10.title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity
GS10.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System / FRED
GS10.description: Constant maturity 10-year Treasury yield, monthly average.

TB3MS.title: 3-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate
TB3MS.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System / FRED
TB3MS.description: Secondary market rate for 3-month Treasury bills, discount basis, monthly average.

transformations.unemployment_change_qoq: UNRATE_t - UNRATE_{t-1} (Quarterly Change in Percentage Points)
transformations.term_spread_10y_3m: GS10 - TB3MS (10-Year Treasury Yield minus 3-Month T-Bill Rate, Percentage Points)

missing_data_treatment: No forward filling across quarterly macro series; strict complete-case alignment for walk-forward evaluation
